say:3:1422104002:1.text: Ah, so you're his confidant. I had wondered about his situation before... Anyway, welcome, please make yourself at home.

say:4:1422104004:1.text: I've asked you to come today, Indris, because there is a delicate family matter I need your help with... My son, Viscount Lolde, has been missing for an entire week.
say:4:1422104004:1.source_cn: 因度厄，我请你前来，是有一桩家事不得不向你求助……我的...

say:6:1422104005:1.text: Yes, your maid told me as much. I need more information, such as where was he when he disappeared? Did anything unusual happen before his disappearance?
say:6:1422104005:1.source_cn: 我需要更多的信息，比如他失踪的地点？失踪之前有没有什么...

say:7:1422104006:1.text: Well, everything seemed normal. However, before his disappearance, someone witnessed a servant trying to lure him to the commoners' district.
say:7:1422104006:1.source_cn: 他失踪之前……一切如常，不过有人目击到，失踪之前曾经有...

say:10:1422104008:0.text: It was me...! Captain Indris, I-I saw it... I swear it's the truth!
say:10:1422104008:0.source_cn: ……！是、是我！夫人，因度厄大人，我看到了……千真万确！

say:11:1422104009:1.text: We've searched the entire royal city and still can't find him. The only explanation is that he was taken to the commoners' district.
say:11:1422104009:1.source_cn: 我的人已经搜寻了王城的每一寸角落，都没有找到他。所以只...

say:13:1422104011:0.text: Someone of his stature? No chance he'd set foot in a place like that by choice!
say:13:1422104011:0.source_cn: 以他尊贵的身份，怎么可能自愿去那种地方！

say:14:1422104012:1.text: Captain, I need you to go to the <style="stress">commoners' district</style> and find Lolde. This must be kept under wraps—no one can know about it, or it could harm our reputation.
say:14:1422104012:1.source_cn: 因度厄，我要你前往<style=stress>平民区<...

say:15:1422104013:1.text: Your task is to bring back my son, not to investigate what happened. Do you understand what I need from you?
say:15:1422104013:1.source_cn: 我给你的任务是把我的儿子带回来，而不是调查真相，你明白...

say:17:1422104015:1.text: Well then... Seya, please help me see our guests off.

say:19:1422104003:1.text: I had wondered... Anyway, anyone so trusted by Captain Indris is welcome. Please make yourself at home.
